visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair and a dark navy shirt holds a small, white cylindrical device to his ear, his mouth moving as he speaks to the camera. The background is a cream-colored wall with a recessed spotlight on the ceiling. (2) The scene cuts to the same man now wearing a white terrycloth bathrobe, standing in an indoor living space with dark cabinets. He holds a white rectangular box with 'Maison Berger Paris' printed on it, using his fingers to open the lid. (3) He reaches inside the box and pulls out a white object wrapped in protective white tissue paper, carefully unwrapping it with both hands. The lighting is bright and even. (4) The man displays a small, square silver foil pouch to the camera, rotating it to show both sides. He then points to a stack of several similar 'Maison Berger Paris' boxes on a light-colored table. (5) He holds a thin, white ceramic disc with a hole in the center up to his nose and mouth, as if demonstrating its scent. The camera captures a medium close-up of his facial expression which appears pleasant. (6) A close-up shows a hand placing the ceramic disc into the base of the white cylindrical device. The device has a grey interior structure. (7) A finger presses a small power button on the bottom side of the white cylinder. A thin blue light ring illuminates around the base of the device. (8) The device is shown sitting on a grey marble-topped counter in a modern bathroom. In the background mirror, the man in the white robe is visible from the back as he adjusts his hair. (9) A montage follows showing the man's hands handling various scent refill boxes. The camera zooms in on labels including 'Ocean Breeze', 'Zest of Verbena', and 'Amber Powder'. (10) The final phase shows the man putting the lid back on the white device and placing it back among the product boxes on the table under bright studio-style lighting.
